effects.display_name: Mimic Octopus Native Owner, Bucket and Attack State
effects.actual_behavior: Original TamableAnimal owner UUID, Player lookup and allies are reused: owner direct equality, other tameable isOwnedBy(owner) including native null behavior, owner allies, parent fallback. Owner retaliation/attack goals remain native; only custom HurtBy canUse requires tame. UPGRADING AND BUCKET STATE ARE THE SAME NATIVE FIELD: isUpgraded/setUpgraded read/write FROM_BUCKET, not the separately initialized unused UPGRADED accessor. Thus native bucket release setFromBucket(true) admits upgraded attacks; feed upgrade also makes fromBucket true. NBT saves both values from that accessor, and read calls setUpgraded then later setFromBucket, so FromBucket wins for differing supplied values. Do not correct this native behavior or invent an independent upgrade state. Raw mimic ordinal clamps0..4 on read; setMimicState saves previous ordinal only when changed. TRANS_PROGRESS rises/falls .25 to5 after state changes and is read as >=5 attack admission, not pure cosmetic. stop/mimic/camo clocks decrement in tick; StopChange gates state replacement, not every damage callback. Goal AIAttack requires tame/livecurrenttarget/exec0 and rejects StopChange+OVERLAY; canUse decrements positive exec and clears laser. It has no canContinue override, so pinned Goal default calls canUse even during continuation. stop resets scare/flee, sets100+rand200 then overwrites30 when isUpgraded; otherwise clears target/lastHurtBy. Creeper tick writes300 but subsequent stop overwrites30 for upgraded, so 300 is not guaranteed effective full cooldown. Native custom setOrderedToSit writes SITTING only, leaving inherited orderedToSit flag unchanged; Vanilla SitWhenOrderedToGoal alone cannot enforce custom command2. Own travel, owner-follow and native attack admission stay distinct. Tamed hand state-choice/toggle/food/upgrade branches are not owner-only; command/item exchange branch is owner-only. Feeding tamefood consumes first, fishFeeds++; tame only OVERLAY/no block with feeds>5 and1/2 or feeds>8. Upgradefood feeds>5 or feeds>2 and1/2 writes sharedbuckettrue/MIMICUBE/StopChangefalse/blocknull/stop40. Bucket extra MimicOctopusData is written to detached CUSTOM_DATA.copyTag without assigning it back, and native ItemModFishBucket uses BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA then setFromBucket. NBT retains owner/command/sitting/mimic clocks/blocks/feed counts; laser ID/time/scare/exec transient. No generic progression or delayed receipt introduced.
